payload.name: Donia Chaiehloudj
payload.bio:
Donia Chaiehloudj is a Software Engineer at Isovalent and a member of the technical community advocacy team, where she focuses on open source, developer education, and sharing practical knowledge through talks, workshops, and technical content. She contributes to the Cilium project, working at the intersection of Kubernetes, Linux networking, and eBPF to improve how distributed systems are secured and observed at runtime. 

Donia is the co-author of Learn Go with Pocket-Sized Projects and has a strong interest in building developer tooling in Go, particularly in networking and observability. Her work focuses on making complex systems more accessible and actionable for developers. 

An active member of the developer community, Donia organizes meetups, speaks at conferences, and contributes to initiatives such as Women Techmakers and CNCF diversity programs. She also hosts the WHAT06 podcast, a local initiative focused on sharing stories and experiences from the tech community, and occasionally contributes to the eCHO podcast. 

Outside of engineering, she enjoys sewing, playing the clarinet, and exploring new hiking trails.

patents.title: Group management of authenticated entities
patents.description: Exemplary embodiments provide various techniques for managing groups of authenticated entities. In one exemplary computer-implemented method, an entity accesses a group roster that includes a first group identifier identifying a first group, a first group digital certificate associated with the first group, and a first entity identifier identifying the entity being a member of the first group. The entity also receives a request to update the group roster. Here, the request includes a second group identifier identifying a second group and a second group digital certificate associated with the second group. In response to the request, the entity replaces the first group identifier in the group roster with the second group identifier. Additionally, in response to the request, the entity replaces the first group digital certificate with the second group digital certificate. The replacements change a membership of the entity from the first group to the second group.

patents.title: Eventual consistency among many clusters including entities in a master member regime
patents.description: The present application provides techniques to interrelate a group of multiple entities. A master entity makes configuration decisions regarding the group of entities and communicates those decisions to the entities. When the master relinquishes the master role, the retiring master selects a new master to accede to the master role. The retiring master releases the master role and ensures that the new master becomes aware of its assignment to the master role. During the time between when the retiring master abdicates and when the new master accedes, the group of entities is temporarily permitted to have no master. The master changes the configuration of the group of entities in a similar way. Using the techniques described herein, a new master may eventually replace the retiring master, and a new configuration may eventually replace the old configuration, without the risk of duplicating or dropping the master role or a configuration change.

patents.title: Status transfer within a group of computing entities
patents.description: A system and method for designating and administering authority in a trusted environment is provided. In some embodiments, a determination is made that a transfer of the authority to a second computing entity is warranted. The second computing entity is opportunistically contacted, and during the opportunistic contact, the authority is passed from the first computing entity to the second computing entity. The passing of the authority from the first computing entity to the second computing entity tasks the second computing entity with updating members of the group of the passing of the authority. The passing of authority may include providing an outstanding group update to the second computing entity and may also include tasking the second computing entity with completing the outstanding group update.

patents.title: Intercluster Relationship Management
patents.description: This application is a continuation of U.S. application Ser. No. 12/416,699, filed on Apr. 1, 2009, entitled "INTERCLUSTER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT", at least some of which may be incorporated herein.

patents.title: Intercluster relationship management
patents.description: Data storage and management systems can be interconnected as clustered systems to distribute data and operational loading. Further, independent clustered storage systems can be associated to form peered clusters. As provided herein, methods and systems for creating and managing intercluster relationships between independent clustered storage systems, allowing the respective independent clustered storage systems to exchange data and distribute management operations between each other while mitigating administrator involvement. Cluster introduction information is provided on a network interface of one or more nodes in a cluster, and intercluster relationships are created between peer clusters. A relationship can be created by initiating contact with a peer using a logical interface, and respective peers retrieving the introduction information provided on the network interface. Respective peers have a role/profile associated with the provided introduction information, which is mapped to the peers, allowing pre-defined access to respective peers.

patents.title: System and method for selection of data paths in a clustered storage system
patents.description: A system and method for selecting data paths among nodes of a clustered storage system is provided. A data path selection module is operatively interconnected with one or more test modules executing on a client computer of the clustered storage system. When invoked, the data path selection module performs an auto discovery process to identify the configuration of the cluster and identifies an appropriate data path to be utilized for either local/remote access to a specified data container.

updates.text: The best customer experiences happen when our people go beyond the transaction and make someone feel genuinely good. On the latest episode of The Nordy Pod, Pete Nordstrom sits down with co-CEO Erik Nordstrom to talk about one of our most meaningful core values, "Extend Yourself," a value that originated with Blake Nordstrom and continues to shape how we show up for our customers every day. The episode also features Carolyn Glick, a loyal Nordstrom customer, and Melanie Briseno, a personal stylist at our Brea store, whose story together is a powerful example of what this value looks like in practice. The episode closes with a personal reflection from Alex Nordstrom in remembrance of her father, Blake. https://lnkd.in/gVQMMWsd

At Nordstrom, we love partnering with some of the best brands in the world to bring great moments to life that make our customers smile. Jellycat's “Road Trip to Joy” has made two new stops at Nordstrom, and we couldn’t be more delighted. Step into Jellycat Cinema at Nordstrom at The Grove in LA, saddle up at Jellycat Ranch at Nordstrom NorthPark Center in Dallas. Each shop is an immersive, playful space for customers of all ages, with exclusive Jellycat characters available only in store at Nordstrom. Whether customers are shopping for a feel-good gift, or adding to their growing Jellycat collection, there’s much to discover and joy to bring home.

Ready to join the Nordstrom team? Stop by any Nordstrom store on Thursday, Nov. 5, from 11 a.m.-5 p.m. for National Hiring Day. Expect on-the-spot interviews and potential same-day offers. No appointment needed. Learn more about open roles: https://lnkd.in/eaiYkFA

Last Thursday, we welcomed brand founders, creators and community partners to our Merrick Park store in Miami for a special evening celebrating our partnership with Latin American Fashion Summit (LAFS), taking place during Latin American & Hispanic Heritage Month. The event kicked off a first-of-its-kind, three-day pop-up featuring a curated roster of Latin American designers, introducing customers to new brands and businesses across ready-to-wear, accessories and jewelry. Featured brands include Bolazo, Dumain, FILIPA, ONHLD, Susana Vega and Sixxta. This collaboration reflects our shared commitment to championing Latin American creativity and diverse entrepreneurial voices. Discover and support Latin American & Hispanic brands year-round through our online product category at Nordstrom and Nordstrom Rack.

We're proud to celebrate Yumi Shin, our EVP of Global Brand Partnerships, on being named to the WWD x FN x Beauty Inc. Women in Power 2026 list — recognizing women who are shaping the future of fashion, footwear, beauty, and retail. Congratulations to Yumi, and the incredible community of brand partners and industry colleagues who are also being honored for their leadership this year! Read more in WWD: https://lnkd.in/eC8cxmme

To achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. updates.text: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud . We're partnering with Google Cloud to bring OpenAI's frontier models and Codex agentic workflows into Google Cloud's model garden, giving enterprises access to our technology in the environment where they already build. Teams will be able to modernize software development and build agentic workflows with Google Cloud's built-in access controls, data governance, and infrastructure. Customers will also be able to purchase OpenAI models through Google Cloud Marketplace and apply existing Google Cloud spend commitments, giving them more flexibility in how they adopt frontier AI. General availability is planned in the coming weeks. Learn more: https://lnkd.in/etZTxJrq

ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 26 new countries, bringing availability to 89 countries worldwide. Over 100,000 advertisers have already run campaigns on ChatGPT. This expansion gives more local businesses and global brands a way to reach people as they explore, compare options, and decide what to buy. The new markets include 14 additional countries in Latin America, along with countries across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. Businesses can get started through Ads Manager or our technology partners. Our ads principles remain the same: conversations stay private from advertisers, ads are clearly labeled and separate from ChatGPT’s answers, and advertising does not influence those answers. Learn more and start advertising: https://ads.openai.com/ https://lnkd.in/ex-v3xmp

We’re expanding access to GPT-Rosalind for academic research. The new Rosalind Academic Plan helps scientific labs at academic institutions bring AI into the work of understanding biology, exploring ideas, and deciding what to test next—with sponsored access for eligible labs at U.S. universities. Academic research creates knowledge that entire fields build on. A fundamental question about biology can open new directions in medicine, drug discovery, or our understanding of disease. We want more researchers to have access to tools that support that work. GPT-Rosalind is built for life sciences research, helping scientists reason across scientific literature and biological data. Researchers bring the expertise and judgment to evaluate the evidence and decide which ideas to pursue. Eligible labs can receive up to 12 months of sponsored access to OpenAI tools, with GPT-Rosalind access subject to trusted-access approval. Learn about the Rosalind Academic Plan, check your lab’s eligibility, and find out how to apply: https://lnkd.in/eP9iXYRu

GPT-6 and Intelligent UI, now rolling out in ChatGPT for everyone. Intelligent UI in ChatGPT delivers fast, interactive answers that make everyday questions more visual, complex topics easier to grasp, and interactive tools for your task available on the spot. With Intelligent UI, GPT‑6 can now compose responses using text, visuals, and interactive elements, choosing how they fit together based on your question. Responses can include graphics and charts to help explain an idea, along with tappable buttons, forms, and interactive experiences you can use directly in your conversation. GPT‑6 with Intelligent UI rolls out globally to Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users today and will expand to Free and Go users starting tomorrow. GPT‑6 in ChatGPT is powered by GPT‑6 Sol for Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise tiers, and GPT‑6 Luna for Free and Go tiers. Both are tuned for everyday conversation. This update applies to the Chat tab in ChatGPT. The models powering Work and Codex are not changing as part of this release. https://lnkd.in/gKCKpQ-R

Today we’re sharing early progress on ChatGPT for Teens, new ways to study and plan for college, and support for the people helping young people prepare for their future. ChatGPT for Teens is automatically applied to accounts identified as under 18, with protections on by default. We’ll continue evaluating the experience and improving it with feedback from teens, families and educators. In one week, nearly 1.2 million teens used Learning Visualizations to explore math and science concepts, and more than 180,000 used Study Mode for step-by-step learning support. Here’s what’s next: • College Planner, coming soon, will bring application requirements, deadlines, tasks and financial-aid steps into one plan. The initial U.S. experience is designed for high-school students in grades 10–12 planning for a four-year college. • More ways to study: scan notes into one PDF on iOS, make flashcards to revisit, and turn uploaded notes into interactive quizzes. • Support for College Advising Corps to expand into new states and create an AI fellowship for advisers. • Three years of support for Boston Children’s Hospital’s Digital Wellness Lab and its independent Student Advisory Council, helping young people test tools and recommend changes. We’ll keep sharing what we learn as ChatGPT for Teens evolves. https://lnkd.in/eZ3dPFMA
